name: Kyogoku (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kyogoku town emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kyogoku, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 August 1957.

features.role: Kyogoku town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a disc
